We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.Location: Germany - RemoteDiscover Impactful WorkThe Senior Technical Sales Specialist (m/f/d) (TSS) for Single-Use Technologies is part of the BioProduction Group sales organization. The role focuses on converting near-term opportunities into revenue, developing a strong pipeline for future growth, and maintaining customer relationships to support organic growth. You’ll apply your sales experience, bioprocess knowledge, product expertise, market intelligence, and territory leadership to grow sales and profitability.A Day in the Life:You’ll identify and develop new opportunities, advance existing opportunities toward closure, and support adoption of new products across your territory. Working with BioProduction Account Managers (BAMs) and Field Application Scientists (FAS), you’ll develop account growth strategies, support sales and account planning, and help match technical solutions to complex customer needs. You’ll also maintain and improve your technical knowledge of assigned product lines, company literature, and driven products.What to expect:- Search for new opportunities and use the product portfolio to build long-term growth.- Advance existing opportunities and act quickly on marketing-qualified leads.- Use intelligence-based prospecting to identify potential customers.- Prioritize New Product Introduction (NPI) prospects to improve adoption and revenue return.- Collaborate with BAMs and FAS colleagues to develop and lead account growth strategies.- Support BioProduction Account Managers with sales and account planning across the assigned territory.- Help develop technical solutions for complex opportunities.- Travel up to 60% within the assigned territory.Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in a life-science related field, such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Engineering.Experience- 7+ years of combined sales or adjacent functional experience in a role related to the bioproduction process.- Single-Use experience is preferred.- Experience with consultative selling and/or hardware equipment sales is a plus.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Technical understanding of bioproduction workflows and applications- a strong understanding of customer challenges and solution development- expert presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders- experience with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications- fluent English and German. Another European language is a plus. A valid driver’s license is required.CompetenciesDemonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and departments. Good judgment and tact when dealing with internal and external customers.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.occupation: Director, Global HRBP BioPharma (m/f/d) (HR Business Partner)
jobs.description: Einleitung/Über unsBiopharma is one of the fastest-growing businesses within the Fresenius Group. We develop, manufacture and commercialize biosimilars that make advanced therapies accessible to more patients. With a strong pipeline and a steady pace of product launches, we combine the agility and ambition of a start-up with the scale of a global healthcare company.As Director Global HRBP Biopharma, you will help ensure our organization, leadership and talent capabilities keep pace with business growth. You will partner with the leaders of Biopharma's commercial organizations outside the United States, with potential scope to support additional business areas. Alongside these HR business partnering responsibilities, you will help shape and coordinate the global Biopharma HR agenda, connecting business priorities with Fresenius Kabi's global HR organization.Reporting to the Vice President HR Biopharma, you will be a member of the Biopharma HR Leadership Team and work closely with the Vice President across the full Biopharma HR agenda.Your responsibilities:- Act as a strategic partner to senior leaders on all HR related questions in particular on organizational effectiveness, talent and leadership development, performance, talent acquisition, engagement initiatives, integration and upscale of our business- Shape organizational design and workforce planning to build teams and capabilities needed for business growth- Support the integration of acquired businesses and teams- Shape and drive the Biopharma HR roadmap, represent business priorities in dialogue with Group HR leadership and Centers of Expertise- Lead the implementation of Group-wide HR programmes across Biopharma- Work closely together and collaborate with local HR organizations- Build and continuously improve HR structures, processes and ways of working that enable consistent delivery of the people agenda in a fast-growing businessYour qualifications:- A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organizational Development or a related field- Extensive experience as an HR Business Partner in a global matrix organization, including partnering with senior leaders and executives- Proven experience supporting international commercial organizations; experience with technical operations organizations would be an advantage- Strong change management expertise and experience translating business priorities into an HR roadmap across multiple countries- Broad HR expertise across disciplines such as organizational design, talent management and reward, combined with the ability to bring structure, set priorities and drive execution- Fluency in English, clear communication and the confidence to challenge constructively, combined with sound judgment, discretion and a calm, collaborative, reliable approach- Qualifications or experience in project management or agile ways of working, such as Scrum, or certification as a professional coach would be beneficial- Experience in pharma, biotech, life sciences or another regulated industryOur offer:Help shape the future of Biopharma. Join #futurefreseniusContactApply through our online portal.

Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading logistics service providers operating worldwide. We offer tailor-made solutions along the entire supply chain for companies from a wide diversity of industries. From multimodal transports to perfect warehousing, from smooth customs clearance to innovative value-added services: We always keep our pulse on the times and are at our customers' side.WHAT YOU CAN EXPECTWe bring together the strongly growth-oriented areas of logistics, analytics, and data in our central Business Analytics & Data Solutions team at Rhenus Warehousing Solutions Germany. In an agile corporate organization, you will immerse yourself in this exciting environment and, together with your teammates, share responsibility for the development of our Data Lakehouse platform in the Microsoft Cloud and make a significant contribution to our transformation into a data-driven company. Above all, the handling of big data has a significant influence on our daily activities and presents us with many exciting challenges.- You create data models from data of our central and operational management systems, ensuring the quality and performance of the models and monitoring them.- You coordinate the requirements with our internal customers, identify needs, make solution- and visualization-recommendations and create a solution concept on this basis.- Based on the data models, you develop reports with MS Power BI and train data experts from the BI community we have created and managing.- You prepare, analyze, and interpret large amounts of data, ensure the quality of complex analyses, work with the team to derive recommendations for action and communicate results to our stakeholders.- We see the expansion of our know-how as an integral part of our work, which is why we focus on continuous exchange within the team, learning phases during working hours, and a selection of training opportunities developed specifically for our team.WHAT YOU BRING- You have a degree in a STEM subject or professional experience in data & analytics. Good English and German language skills are required.- You have experience in modelling, analyzing and visualizing data with Microsoft Power BI. Practical experience in a cloud-based data processing platform (e.g. Databricks or Snowflake) and knowledge of SQL, Python and Spark are an advantage.- You enjoy sharing your knowledge and celebrating successes together as a team.- You are not afraid to actively approach colleagues and internal customers to discuss requirements and present solutions.- You make use of your mature understanding of (logistic) processes and IT and can distinguish yourself through a solution-oriented, self-organized way of working.YOUR BENEFITS- Agile Environment: Embrace a dynamic work culture, where you and your team adapt quickly to meet evolving needs.- Flat Hierarchies: Get straight through to the decision-makers with our streamlined organizational structure.- Flexible Working Hours: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.- Great Team: It's truly the people that make the difference - and with us you'll join the best team around.- Modern Equipment: Work with cutting-edge tools and technology designed for peak performance.- Personalized Growth: Accelerate your career with development opportunities, tailored to your talents and interests.
